v10-konoba-atlantic-kitchen.name: Konoba Atlantic Kitchen
tags: TripAdvisor Travellers' Choice — quiet local reputation since 2017
EUR 30–45 pp
Book the small terrace 3–5 days ahead
Evening on the Lapad bay side
v10-konoba-atlantic-kitchen.why: TripAdvisor Travellers' Choice — quiet local reputation since 2017. To order: house-made pappardelle with prawn-walnut sauce · cuttlefish-ink ravioli · grilled tuna. When the Old Town is full of cruise traffic, this is where the city's professionals eat. Smaller portions, sharper plating than the konobas inside the walls.
v10-konoba-atlantic-kitchen.hours: Evening on the Lapad bay side
v10-konoba-atlantic-kitchen._lane: Where the city eats when the Old Town is full

v13-pizzeria-tabasco.name: Pizzeria Tabasco
tags: Long-running local pizzeria — the antidote to Stradun frozen pizza
EUR 15–25 pp
Walk-in usually fine; book the terrace in July–Aug
Late dinner, terrace looks at the lit walls
v13-pizzeria-tabasco.why: Long-running local pizzeria — the antidote to Stradun frozen pizza. To order: Tabasco house pizza (salami, jalapeño, tabasco-honey drizzle) · seafood spaghetti · house tiramisu. Family-friendly, fast, honest. Where local crews eat after service. Pizza is wood-fired, dough is rested overnight.
v13-pizzeria-tabasco.hours: Late dinner, terrace looks at the lit walls

v-taj-mahal.name: Taj Mahal (Bosnian grill)
v-taj-mahal.verdict: Despite the name, a Bosnian grill: ćevapi, minced-meat fingers grilled over charcoal and served in lepinja flatbread with raw onion and ajvar, plus klepe, sogan dolma and burek. Honest Balkan cooking, not a theme park.
v-taj-mahal.signature: Ćevapi in lepinja with onion and ajvar.
v-taj-mahal._lane: Where the city eats when the Old Town is full

v14-d-vino-wine-bar.name: D'vino Wine Bar
tags: The reference Croatian-wine bar of the Old Town · ten consecutive Michelin Guide editions
EUR 25–55 pp (flights ~EUR 15–25)
Book the cellar table; bar walk-in
Aperitivo 18:00–20:00 before a Stara Loža dinner
v14-d-vino-wine-bar.why: The reference Croatian-wine bar of the Old Town · ten consecutive Michelin Guide editions. To order: Plavac Mali flight (Grgić · Miloš · Madirazza · Saints Hills) · Pošip flight · Grk single-pour from Lumbarda. Map your Pelješac and Korčula wine list in one sitting. Owner Saša will pour you Grk you cannot find anywhere else in the Old Town.
v14-d-vino-wine-bar.hours: Aperitivo 18:00–20:00 before a Stara Loža dinner
v14-d-vino-wine-bar._lane: The glass — a wine bar and two Pelješac cellars

v17-grgi-vina-cellar-door.name: Grgić Vina (cellar door)
tags: Founded 1996 by Miljenko "Mike" Grgich — Paris-1976 winemaker's homecoming
Tasting EUR 25–45 pp
Email at least 1 week ahead — small, by-appointment tastings
Late-morning, then lunch at Bota Šare 50 min away
v17-grgi-vina-cellar-door.why: Founded 1996 by Miljenko "Mike" Grgich — Paris-1976 winemaker's homecoming. To order: Plavac Mali Grgić (the multi-vintage flagship) · Pošip Grgić. Mike Grgich died in 2023; his daughter Violet and nephew Ivo Jeramaz run the estate. Two wines only, every year, no exceptions.
v17-grgi-vina-cellar-door.hours: Late-morning, then lunch at Bota Šare 50 min away
v17-grgi-vina-cellar-door._lane: The glass — a wine bar and two Pelješac cellars

v18-milo-stagnum.name: Miloš Stagnum
tags: Hugh Johnson called Stagnum "Croatia's first cult wine" · wild yeast, 3 years in old oak
Tasting EUR 35–60 pp
Visit by appointment only — Frano Miloš personally pours
Late afternoon — the 45° slopes catch the last light
v18-milo-stagnum.why: Hugh Johnson called Stagnum "Croatia's first cult wine" · wild yeast, 3 years in old oak. To order: Stagnum (top cuvée, 3 y oak) · Plavac Mali base · Pošip Korčula. 15 ha across south-facing 150–250 m slopes. The 1993 Stagnum the wine that put Croatia on the international map after the war.
v18-milo-stagnum.hours: Late afternoon — the 45° slopes catch the last light
v18-milo-stagnum._lane: The glass — a wine bar and two Pelješac cellars

v16-gru-market-tr-nica-gru.name: Gruž Market (Tržnica Gruž)
tags: The provisioning market — closest fresh-fish market to ACI Marina
Bring small bills
06:30–09:00 — boats land 06:30, fish gone by 10:00
v16-gru-market-tr-nica-gru.why: The provisioning market — closest fresh-fish market to ACI Marina. To order: fish-hall: scorpionfish, sea bream, monkfish, the morning's octopus · outdoor: tomato, fig, mandolins of olive oil, herbs. Cash only on most stalls. The walk from Gruž ACI Marina is 8 minutes. Mondays are quiet; the rest of the week is the run.
v16-gru-market-tr-nica-gru._lane: La Rue — the market, the sandwich, the octopus burger

v12-buffet-kola.name: Buffet Škola
tags: Tiny family sandwich shop · over 50 years on the same lane
EUR 8–15 pp
Walk-in only, three tables outside
Crew breakfast 09:00–11:00; quick lunch any time
v12-buffet-kola.why: Tiny family sandwich shop · over 50 years on the same lane. To order: homemade-bread sandwich with Drniš pršut and Konavle cheese · domestic glass of red. Bread baked on site. Cash strongly preferred. The pršut comes off Drniš bone; the cheese is the Konavle hard-pressed sheep.
v12-buffet-kola.hours: Crew breakfast 09:00–11:00; quick lunch any time
v12-buffet-kola._lane: La Rue — the market, the sandwich, the octopus burger

v-barba.name: Barba
v-barba.verdict: Slow Dalmatian fast food: Adriatic fish in fast-food formats — an octopus burger, a fish taco, salted-cod croquettes. A counter and a handful of tables, walk-in.
v-barba._lane: La Rue — the market, the sandwich, the octopus burger
